_note: DEMO DATA. PairUp Points are small unstaffed hand-off spots, each watched by one Ring camera or doorbell. These are planned demo locations for the UW Seattle market; no devices are installed there. ring_device_id links a point to a Ring device: set it here, or with RING_POINT_DEVICES=pt_uw_hub=<device id> (npm run ring:probe lists your device ids).
